def transform(grid):
    # The divider color is the only color forming full grid lines.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {c: sum(v == c for row in grid for v in row) for c in range(10)}
    candidates = [c for c in range(10) if any(sum(v == c for v in row) >= w // 2 for row in grid) and any(sum(grid[r][j] == c for r in range(h)) >= h // 2 for j in range(w))]
    divider = min(candidates, key=lambda c: counts[c])
    # Divider rows/columns are periodic; gaps in them are the background color.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == divider for v in grid[r]) >= w // 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == divider for r in range(h)) >= h // 2]
    background = max(counts, key=lambda c: counts[c])
    gaps = [(r, c) for r in rows for c in cols if grid[r][c] == background]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in gaps), max(r for r, c in gaps)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in gaps), max(c for r, c in gaps)
    return [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]
